test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.

DGJM

NQTW

TWZC

HIJK
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- Difference between the position values according to English alphabetic series is (3)

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : TWZC

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe91e1ae4ca9f560a8bc75ce751ede238c6cba97745075ea528a3753a28918e9.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : NQTW

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b5ba94ab55b245f406e29d5b6d768d0c959588b71cde81b76c9df96a6e98a33.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : HIJK

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/536a6a91ef3f631071d541ff940103ccbb7d57ae63e95a8db26dd734db242cbb.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : DGJM

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/959716740c8525d0e1a77aba56ea4727a37c0053a3d2ded1e28c2eac4876d65b.png] 

Thus, out of all the options '**HIJK**' is the odd one out as the difference between the letters is (1) respectively.

​Hence, "**HIJK**" is the correct answer.
